detail.longDescription: Early in my professional career, a co-worker shared an important piece of wisdom: Know what not to write, know what not to commit. Not every function, interface, or line of code written during development needs to be part of the final change. Some things can be left on the cutting room floor. https:// chipx86.blog/2026/08/20/know-w hat-not-to-commit/ # blog # programming # development
